title: Lower the complete rank-seven native bound by 340
body:
## Summary

Twenty-four exact commuting contractions remove 27 A gates and 27 inverse cleanup gates from each six-skip provider. They compose with PR3060's disjoint restore improvement.

```text
                               PR3060       this result
A gates                          4079           4052
inverse cleanup gates            5216           5189
complete forward bound         158124         157784
complete backward bound        158172         157832
```

The complete native primitive bound falls by 340 per word and orientation. This is an explicitly scoped compiler-bound improvement, with unchanged recursive profile and kappa. Only `research/rank7-commuting-contractions/` is added, including proof, literal edit certificate, exact frozen source exports, deterministic receipt and reproduction instructions.

## Evidence

[Canonical finding and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18983767).

- **Before:** PR3060's pinned source leaves these commuting A updates separate. **After:** each witness checks exact rational coefficients, arbitrary-dirty operator equality, every intervening commutation and strict tariff decrease. Cleanup is derived afresh. All non-scalar emitted events, 408 ordered helper widths and 91 private buffers remain charged.
- Six complete native transport/emitter pairs cover both providers and PR3042/PR3060/new words, all 632 live inputs in both orientations. Eleven behavioral groups, semantic/source/cost rejection controls, optimized execution, Python 3.14 receipt equality, strict Ruff checks and compilation pass. Two internal read-only reviews found no blocking issue; one independently reconstructed all 704 ordinary scalar input columns and all source Git blobs. All 28 committed files match tested publication bytes.
- Canonical main remains `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6. Live overlap and current handoffs were refreshed before submission. The bounded shared-update attempt found no verified recursive gain; no exclusion theorem or new kappa is claimed.

```sh
TMPDIR="$RUN/tmp" python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/rank7-commuting-contractions
```

`RUN` is an external session-owned directory with an existing `tmp` subdirectory. Full commands and source pins are in the package README.

Credit PR3060/3056 for the inherited restore substitution, cleanup/frame helpers and replay pattern; dcharb78/PR3042, Jeremy Kothe/PR3015, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Sagar Thakrar, Gareth Davidson, Cinna Davis, icekylinx, Tekalign and the retained native/geometry/owner lineage.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

The metric is a conservative native compiler bound, not measured runtime or materialized instruction count. Physical coefficient-stream precision/storage, ownership, all-size/compiler and supplier/outer admission remain separate. Frozen predecessors and the selected frontier are unchanged. Hosted CI is separate from local verification.
